statement: This sketch creates a living network of interconnected geometric forms that pulse and shift in real time. The system consists of hundreds of nodes that move independently across the canvas, bouncing off the edges, while constantly forming and dissolving connections between each other based on proximity. Each node carries its own hue that slowly shifts through the color spectrum, creating a dynamic chromatic interplay as they connect and separate. The visual rhythm is driven by the continuous motion and morphing of these forms — their sizes subtly pulse with sine waves, and their connections fade in and out as distances change. The result is an organic, ever-evolving structure that feels both systematic and chaotic, reflecting the tension between stability and transformation described in the brief.
